name: contextmesh-code
about: Questions answered by the docstrings and comments of this repository's own Python source (contextmesh/). Each answerable question names the file a correct answer comes from and phrases it contains; out-of-scope questions should be refused.

answerable.q: Why is a slug id not proof of identity?
When does an edge survive an as-of projection?
Why are routes through a source that every claim derives from priced up?
Where are the numbers the dashboard renders computed?
What does a name that already resolves to a known entity get registered as?
Is a decision ever revived when invalidated work is redone?
Does TaskRegistry.describe expose module paths or callables?
Why does parse_date refuse loose dates like March?
Why is the evidence intake boundary the last place to use a truncated digest?
How much memory did counting every run of words cost per MB of text?
Which edges does refreshing never touch when linking new entities?
What does the bundled corpus give the pipeline that a real folder lacks?
Why do useful backward reversals of an edge land on a claim or a decision?
Is a stored ledger digest regenerated on load?
How many bytes does reading one file allow at most?
Why is a source whose retrieved_at will not parse reported rather than hidden?

out_of_scope: What is the refund policy for annual plans?
What is the capital of Australia?
How do I configure Kubernetes autoscaling for a web service?
What is the recommended dose of ibuprofen?
When is the team offsite in Lisbon?
